resources.string: Leaves Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, backs out of Shorts, Reels and TikTok pages in browsers like Chrome, and closes short-video apps like TikTok and Moj, while "Block Reels & Shorts" is on in AdWizz. In apps it only checks which screen is open; in browsers it only reads the address bar. It does not read your messages or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.
